source.rationale: RE-PINNED at live df165492 (media-intake promote). The OLD fixture was not wrong about behaviour, it encoded a DEAD INPUT CONTRACT: patch-transcript used to sit under `whisper-transcribe` and read the transcript off `$json.text`. That node is gone from live (so are fetch-audio / if-audio-in / if-voice-allowed / send-voice-not-allowed); the node is now fed by `if-media-ok[0]`, i.e. a `media-route` item with action='continue', and reads `rendered_text`. Feeding it the old {text} shape made `String(route.rendered_text || '')` return '' and the test failed for the right reason - a stale INPUT, so this is a fixture fix, not a live behaviour change. Input rebuilt from media-route's own `out('continue', ...)` envelope (export/live-spine-sorento-consume-main/nodes/media-route.js). Expected re-derived from the body, not frozen: deep-copy the popped queue item; on E (item.message.message.message.message) stash `source_url` = the old attachment url and `source_type` = the old attachment type, then neutralise BOTH `E.attachment.type` and `E.type` to 'text' so the surviving `if-message-is-audio` gate (which reads $('tf-message').first().json.message.message.attachment.type === 'audio') takes its FALSE branch; set E.text to the CRM's rendered_text; stamp the legacy `_transcribed`/`_transcript` pair (send-transcript-confirm still reads `_transcript`) plus the new `_media` block that compile-current-state's MI-D confirm-prefix reads. ctx keeps the real nested redis-pop shape (grounded in escalation-context/exec-13442024.json) and now carries `attachment.type` = 'audio', which the old ctx omitted - without it `source_type` could never be anything but null and the new key would be pinned meaningless.
